summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by Pieria — by lot the bride of Lampus son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus by Gorgo married the Pieria maidens at Argos; distinct from Ocypete the Harpy daughter of Thaumas.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Ocypete fifth among the daughters of Danaus borne on Pieria. When the sons of Egyptus by Gorgo cast lots for the Pieria maidens, Lampus drew Ocypete. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom — Hyginus counts her among the brides who obeyed Danaus.
